item.text: The SVG uses a sage envelope and a checkmark, with just 3 pixels of movement over a seven-second loop. It has a transparent background and stays still when reduced motion is enabled. I’m checking the file now.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
p = Path('caught-up.svg')
root = ET.parse(p).getroot()
ns = {'svg': 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'}
assert root.attrib['viewBox'] == '0 0 240 180'
assert root.find('svg:title', ns).text == \"You're all caught up\"
assert root.find('svg:desc', ns) is not None
style = root.find('svg:style', ns).text
assert '7s ease-in-out infinite' in style
assert 'prefers-reduced-motion: reduce' in style
assert 'animation: none' in style
assert root.find('.//svg:script', ns) is None
print(f'Valid, self-contained SVG: {p.stat().st_size:,} bytes')
PY"
